RailWise AI 0.5.5

本版完善持续任务、工程文档交付和下载品牌统一。

- 任务保持连续：状态询问、中途补充、暂停和继续按任务处理，独立新任务保留原任务。普通界面以目标、进度、待办和成果为主，内部执行标识收纳到诊断中。
- 补充、人工待办、检查点和操作回执持久保存；重启时核验执行归属和未结操作，结果不明的副作用不会盲目重放。
- 任务工作台实时展示根任务、子任务汇总、成果和需处理事项；新增监测报告、招投标技术文件、研究报告三个交付模板。
- 文档候选提供来源、正文差异及接受/拒绝操作；提交前再次检查文件版本，发生冲突时保留双方内容和历史。
- 新安装包统一命名为 RailWise AI，官网使用新的下载命名空间；旧更新入口、安装身份、配置、插件及用户资料继续兼容。

下载文件：

- Apple Silicon：`RailWise-AI-0.5.5-mac-Apple-Silicon.dmg`
- Intel：`RailWise-AI-0.5.5-mac-Intel.dmg`
- Windows x64：`RailWise-AI-0.5.5-win-x64.exe`

兼容及已知限制：

- macOS 应用使用 Developer ID 签名并完成公证。Windows 本版未配置 Authenticode 证书，安装程序和可执行文件未签名。
- 长任务在应用 Runtime 存活时执行；退出或休眠后保存状态，重新启动时恢复符合条件的任务。没有安装系统常驻服务。
- 工程报告属于可审阅草稿，缺少阈值、规范或项目条件时需补充资料；AI 检查不替代专业审定。
- v0.5.4 历史资产保留原名称，不覆盖历史下载文件。

+# RailWise AI 0.5.5: final-source build and focused verification
+
+Packaged source: `02165b64bffe5e24f4a4f50811d22086f1489299`.
+Source package version remains 0.5.4. The existing release workflow applies
+`WORKWISE_APP_VERSION=0.5.5` when producing the formal 0.5.5 packages.
+
+On 2026-11-09, in the isolated checkout of that exact source:
+
+- `node --test scripts/release-promotion-recovery.test.mjs scripts/repair-website-cache.test.mjs`: 30 passed, zero failed/skipped.
+- `node --test scripts/release-gate.test.mjs`: 494 passed, one non-Windows parser test skipped, zero failed. This includes a regression for formal tags whose evidence commit follows the actual packaged-source commit.
+- `npm run build`: passed, including the main, preload, and renderer production builds.
+
+The focused cases cover branded publication recovery, canonical and legacy
+download verification, metadata cache migration, idempotency, rejection of
+incomplete managed configuration, and restoration after Nginx failure.
+
+The final source's Quality workflow is run
+[`42624327229`](https://github.com/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/actions/runs/42624327229).
+All three jobs passed: the main quality/build job, Electron production smoke,
+and native Windows path/spawn/persistence. The main job recorded 4,091 desktop
+tests passed (9 skipped), 3,306 KUN tests passed (22 skipped), and 493 release-gate
+tests passed (one non-Windows parser test skipped). Brand, OpenSpec, license,
+lint, type checks and production build also passed. Release approval verifies
+the actual source, jobs and successful result again through GitHub's API.
+
+The preceding PR's broader release tests passed (671 passed, one
+non-Windows PowerShell parser test skipped), together with type checking and
+production build. Final-source CI runs the source-owned test matrix again.
+No new blanket UI matrix, independent AI review, or two-hour freeze is required."},{"sha":"c9aece453b295858075a2b0f80b287a066caeedf","filename":"docs/qa/release-gates/v0.5.5/exact-build-run.json","status":"added","additions":245,"deletions":0,"changes":245,"blob_url":"https://github.com/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/blob/f809b3b27ece254b8cfee17d0308f5fbbbc94753/docs%2Fqa%2Frelease-gates%2Fv0.5.5%2Fexact-build-run.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/raw/f809b3b27ece254b8cfee17d0308f5fbbbc94753/docs%2Fqa%2Frelease-gates%2Fv0.5.5%2Fexact-build-run.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/contents/docs%2Fqa%2Frelease-gates%2Fv0.5.5%2Fexact-build-run.json?ref=f809b3b27ece254b8cfee17d0308f5fbbbc94753","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,245 @@

+# RailWise AI 0.5.5
+
+本版完善持续任务、工程文档交付和下载品牌统一。
+
+- 任务保持连续：状态询问、中途补充、暂停和继续按任务处理，独立新任务保留原任务。普通界面以目标、进度、待办和成果为主，内部执行标识收纳到诊断中。
+- 补充、人工待办、检查点和操作回执持久保存；重启时核验执行归属和未结操作，结果不明的副作用不会盲目重放。
+- 任务工作台实时展示根任务、子任务汇总、成果和需处理事项；新增监测报告、招投标技术文件、研究报告三个交付模板。
+- 文档候选提供来源、正文差异及接受/拒绝操作；提交前再次检查文件版本，发生冲突时保留双方内容和历史。
+- 新安装包统一命名为 RailWise AI，官网使用新的下载命名空间；旧更新入口、安装身份、配置、插件及用户资料继续兼容。
+
+下载文件：
+
+- Apple Silicon：`RailWise-AI-0.5.5-mac-Apple-Silicon.dmg`
+- Intel：`RailWise-AI-0.5.5-mac-Intel.dmg`
+- Windows x64：`RailWise-AI-0.5.5-win-x64.exe`
+
+兼容及已知限制：
+
+- macOS 应用使用 Developer ID 签名并完成公证。Windows 本版未配置 Authenticode 证书，安装程序和可执行文件未签名。
+- 长任务在应用 Runtime 存活时执行；退出或休眠后保存状态，重新启动时恢复符合条件的任务。没有安装系统常驻服务。
+- 工程报告属于可审阅草稿，缺少阈值、规范或项目条件时需补充资料；AI 检查不替代专业审定。
+- v0.5.4 历史资产保留原名称，不覆盖历史下载文件。"},{"sha":"8b8fa8f8a36188a2306ba93f970ca56aa1787714","filename":"docs/qa/release-gates/v0.5.5/required-ci-run.json","status":"added","additions":224,"deletions":0,"changes":224,"blob_url":"https://github.com/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/blob/f809b3b27ece254b8cfee17d0308f5fbbbc94753/docs%2Fqa%2Frelease-gates%2Fv0.5.5%2Frequired-ci-run.json","raw_url":"https://github.com/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/raw/f809b3b27ece254b8cfee17d0308f5fbbbc94753/docs%2Fqa%2Frelease-gates%2Fv0.5.5%2Frequired-ci-run.json","contents_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/railwise-cn/railwise-ai/contents/docs%2Fqa%2Frelease-gates%2Fv0.5.5%2Frequired-ci-run.json?ref=f809b3b27ece254b8cfee17d0308f5fbbbc94753","patch":"@@ -0,0 +1,224 @@
